items.headline: It's finally here — GTA VI launches today
items.body: After years of hype and a string of delays, Grand Theft Auto VI is out now on PS5 and Xbox — likely the biggest entertainment launch ever. Reviews landed just ahead of release (Rockstar tends to live in the mid-90s on Metacritic), and it drops you into a sun-soaked, modern Vice City with dual leads Jason and Lucia.
items.say: GTA 6 is actually out today — people have been waiting years for this one. They're saying it could be the biggest launch in entertainment history. You playing it, or know someone who suddenly came down with a 'cold' today?

items.headline: Jalen Johnson's triple-double sinks SGA and the Thunder
items.body: Atlanta pulled off the upset of the night, knocking off the high-flying Thunder 117-112 behind Jalen Johnson's 16-point, 12-rebound, 11-assist triple-double. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander poured in 34, but it wasn't enough — the Hawks hung on down the stretch.
items.say: The Hawks knocked off SGA's Thunder last night — Jalen Johnson had a triple-double to do it. That kid's quietly turning into a star. You catching any NBA this year?

items.headline: Track meet in Miami — Heat outgun the Bucks 137-130
items.body: Miami and Milwaukee combined for 267 points in a wild, no-defense shootout, with the Heat coming out on top 137-130. Giannis Antetokounmpo stuffed the stat sheet with 27 points and 14 rebounds in the loss — it just wasn't enough to keep pace.
items.say: Heat and Bucks put up 267 combined points last night — basically a layup line. Giannis had 27 and 14 and still lost. Fun one to have on in the background. You a Giannis guy?

items.headline: NFL heads south — Vikings and 49ers play Sunday night in Mexico City
items.body: Week 11 closes with a trip abroad: the Vikings and 49ers take Sunday Night Football to Mexico City, one of the loudest international crowds the league draws. It headlines a loaded Sunday that also has Dolphins-Bills and Cardinals at the Chiefs.
items.say: The NFL's playing a Sunday night game down in Mexico City this weekend — Vikings and Niners. Those crowds down there go absolutely nuts. You riding with anybody this season?

items.headline: The Premier League is back — and the title race is wide open
items.body: Club football returns from the international break this weekend with Manchester City out front and defending champions Arsenal right on their heels. Saturday is stacked — Newcastle host Arsenal, City welcome Fulham and Chelsea face Leeds — before Liverpool and Manchester United close things out on Sunday.
items.say: Premier League's back this weekend after the break — City are leading, Arsenal are chasing, and there's a full card of big games. My favorite stretch of the season. You follow the Prem at all?

items.headline: Europe's giants are back next week — Champions League Matchday 5
items.body: The Champions League returns November 24-25 with a monster round: Arsenal host Borussia Dortmund, Manchester City take on Napoli, and Bayern, Liverpool and Real Madrid are all in action as the league phase tightens up around the knockout places.
items.say: Champions League is back next week — Arsenal-Dortmund and Man City-Napoli are the ones to circle. Those midweek European nights are the best. You ever watch the Champions League?

items.headline: The spice flows one more time — the 'Dune: Part Three' trailer is here
items.body: Denis Villeneuve's trilogy-capping finale hits theaters December 18, and the full trailer has fans buzzing. Adapted from 'Dune Messiah,' it jumps ahead to a battle-hardened Paul (Timothée Chalamet) at war — and sets up a box-office showdown with 'Avengers: Doomsday,' which opens the very same day.
items.say: The final Dune movie has a trailer out — it's in theaters in December, going head-to-head with the new Avengers on the exact same day. Those movies are unreal on a big screen. You into Dune?

links.text: Dune: Part Three — Official Trailer (Warner Bros.)

items.headline: Disney conjures something new — 'Hexed' flies in for Thanksgiving
items.body: Walt Disney Animation's first original, non-sequel film in three years opens November 25: 'Hexed,' a magical coming-of-age adventure set in a world of witches, with Hailee Steinfeld, Rashida Jones and Stephen Fry lending their voices. A fresh pick for the holiday-week family outing.
items.say: Disney's got a brand-new animated witch movie, 'Hexed,' out for Thanksgiving — their first original one in a few years. Could be a fun one to take the kids to. You seen the trailer yet?

items.headline: U2 are back — 'Carnaval De Luz' is their first new album in years
items.body: The rock legends just dropped their 16th studio album, 'Carnaval De Luz' — their first set of brand-new originals since 2017. Bono and the band headline a busy New Music Friday, and it's got plenty of people digging back into the catalog.
items.say: U2 put out their first new album in years — kind of wild they're still at it. 'Beautiful Day' still holds up, right? You a U2 fan, or more of a skip-to-the-hits person?
